quotes.text:
* - Progress/status updates will be communicated to the GUI window.
 * - When the operation completes, listener.onStopRunningUrl() will be called.
 * - listener.onStartRunningUrl() is never called.
 * - The operation is considered complete when all the folders have been
 *   compacted.
 * - It's safe to call this with an empty list of folders. The listener
 *   will still be called.
 * - The listener will _never_ be called before AsyncCompactFolders()
 *   returns.
 * - If AsyncCompactFolders() returns a failure code, no listener callbacks
 *   will be invoked.

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: Current mbox reports compaction support true; Maildir reports false. Shared AsyncCompactFolders filters unsupported stores and still begins an empty BatchCompactor; its documented contract promises a completion listener for an empty list, no start listener, no callback before return, and no callback if the call returns failure. Preserve these distinctions when testing Exchange CompactAll with an unsupported store or no candidates. This is source/documented-contract inspection, not an executed callback order guarantee for a modified implementation. This is static source and test-code inspection. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check ran. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline and inline discussion remain pending; source landing does not prove approval of a proposed manual rule.
title: Store support and empty compaction batches have distinct outcomes
